method: Controlled cottage vacancy follows actual departure. Published firm capacity is enlarged to isolate causes; no residents, money, skills, stock or wages granted. Funding stress moves existing payroll cash into region then exactly reverses it; access stress removes and restores the same road tiles; construction stress marks then completes redevelopment on the same empty cottage. Blocked admission attempted once; after exact repair at most 40 ordinary probabilistic invitations, without RNG overrides. This proves causal recovery boundaries, not organic job creation or player construction costs.
